mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may potentiate ezetimibe's cholesterol-lowering effects and increase risk of electrolyte-related cardiac arrhythmias; ezetimibe may compete for hepatic metabolism pathways.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium), lipid panel, and cardiac function regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent if clinically indicated.
